items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: But, uh, Baby Dots, he played with Ridgely a while. He was with the Tuxedo Band a while.

ctx.x: At that time, Ernest Rapania, he was another drummer. But, you know, he, I didn't like his orchestra drumming, but he was a fine bass drummer in brass bands. And he played with Ridgely's brass band. Oh, yeah. The Tuxedo Brass Band. He played with Tuxedo Brass Band and also Henry Zeno played with orchestra and the brass band at one time, see. And, uh, well, I didn't, you know, look, care about any other drummers outside. Henry Martin was not, he was not a real drummer. I liked him. I liked him. But, uh, Baby Dots,…
But you began working about nineteen sixteen when you were sixteen, you say? That's my first job. I played with a teacher.
